Note: Digitisation: the markers of this figure were pixel-digitised from the embedded page bitmap (1950 x 3000 px, 8-bit grey) by Huttenlocher__1979_Figures3-6_extract.py (conda env 'python'; pymupdf, numpy, scipy), run 2026-10-31; a second run reports 'snapshot unchanged'. Open markers are located as the white region each outline encloses; filled markers by eroding the dark mask with a disk, which removes the fitted curve and the error bars. ESTIMATED ERROR +/- 10 g. POINTS CONTAINED vs RESOLVED: the figure contains 10 plotted points and all 10 were individually resolved; none was inferred. The paper prints no count and no brain-weight value, so there is nothing in the text to check an individual weight against; the build checks only that the adult and newborn values fall in the normal human range and reports that the adult/2-year increase digitises to 7.2% against the 'about 20%' the text states (p. 202) - reported, not reconciled.
